doc: M3-C09-03: the Ebbing's motes (EbbingMotes, game/vfx/ebbing/ebbing_motes.gd; docs/kb/tech/ebbing.md). Ch9's held fields by the .dlg cue's mark (`@vfx glimmer_held at=<mark>`), every one HELD (act1_ch09.md §9 rule 1: no release, no gold, nothing rises). Field extents are GlimmerField's (disc: x radius, y half height); amount is its amount_multiplier over glimmer.json's base, tier-scaled by the field. `ends` stops earlier fields when a later one starts (their motes run out their life and sink).
_sea_note: Out of the harbour mouth: from the harbour_stream mark toward harbour_mouth (+Z, a little east), the heading the Ch8 storm came in on.
_water_note: The zone's Tide water_height_y: held motes sink through it and are absorbed; the still-water mirror plane.

staff._note: One attractor on the lantern-staff's head, following Asha (a StaffHead node the rig puts on her body at head_offset_m, raised). Pull low enough that the stream lags and sinks behind it (item 3; tests/unit/test_ebbing_motes.gd checks the median heading stays down at the staff's highest point).

mourners._note: Grief anchors on the kneeling mourners (item 4): slow orbits, and as the staff passes within pass_radius_m each one's pull eases to nothing over ramp_s, so the motes leave reluctantly.

wallhead_motes._note: N13, the cutaway: seaward behind Kerrid, no attractor at all and not the scene focus (item 8).
